market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio is not a frontrunner for the 2028 Republican nomination; he is likely to be overshadowed by Trump's VP or more prominent figures like DeSantis or Haley. His 2016 primary campaign showed limited appeal. Even if nominated, the general election would be competitive. A 5% chance of winning the presidency is more realistic than 13.7%.
evidence_points: Rubio's 2016 primary performance was weak (only won MN, DC, PR)
Early 2028 Republican positioning points to stronger contenders like a Trump VP or a DeSantis/Haley rematch
Historical base rates for sitting Senators winning the presidency are low, and Rubio lacks a clear path to nomination
